{{Quote|Skywalker, Balmorra is the nesting ground of the giant Neebray mantas!|Plo Koon informs Skywalker of the danger|<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />}}
The '''Balmorra Run''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]' [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that approached the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]].

{{Route-stub}}

==History==
The hyperlane was named for its popularity with [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorran]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]] was situated on it and was the nesting grounds of the [[Neebray/Legends|neebray]] manta.<ref name="TCW:TVG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> Anakin Skywalker used it as a shortcut in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> to get his task force to the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']]. While en route to the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]], [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]] encountered the mantas, leading to the accidental damage of several fighters.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />
